_help: IQ Capital Futures Core 50K, Position Loss version, from iqcapital.io (checked 12 Oct 2026). 30 days, extendable by 30 days for $19 as often as needed. Commissions are estimates: check your platform statement.
_position_loss_help: No single position may lose $500 (1%) or more including costs: 2 soft breaches, the 3rd closes the account. Not modelled by the simulators; keep planned risk at $450 or less so it never triggers.
_alternative: Daily Loss version ($49): max_drawdown 2000, daily_loss_limit 1000, no position loss rule.
_trail_lock_help: Balance at which the trailing threshold stops moving up. IQ Capital: trails until the starting balance, then stays fixed.
_daily_loss_help: None on the Position Loss version. (Daily Loss version: $1,000 soft breach, modelled as 'stop for the day'.)
_consistency_help: No consistency rule during the challenge (30% best-day rule applies once funded).
_costs_help: Round-turn commission + fees per contract (estimate), and slippage in ticks per round turn.
_plan_help: Your trading plan (PLAYBOOK.md sections 15-18): MNQ, $350 flat risk, 50-point structure stops, IB/ORB breakouts at about 1.5R and 50% wins. max_days 63 = about 3 months (two $19 extensions); extend rather than raise risk.
